items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Milford Graves was the drummer, he played like he played with everybody, he played great.

ctx.x: And, um, I remember Milford Graves was the drummer, he played like he played with everybody, he played great. Umm, he didn’t scream. It’s the saxophones, those damn saxophones. I didn’t scream, I just tried to, you know, fit in a note once in awhile when it seemed appropriate. And, that was... Billy Taylor refused to announce it. It was... we were so awful.
